WITH latest_stage AS (
    SELECT symbol, market_cap_cat, sector, stage, trading_signal,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY symbol ORDER BY snapshot_date DESC) AS rn
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
)
SELECT ce.symbol, ce.event_type, ce.event_date, ss.stage, ss.sector, ss.market_cap_cat
FROM signals.corporate_events ce
JOIN latest_stage ss ON ce.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
  AND ss.rn = 1
  AND ss.stage = 'STAGE_2'
LIMIT 100;
